name: Night Watch
intent: Linked containers at working weight, one level after they were taught, and the last Night Sky level. Two ropes instead of one, on a deck that now has nine colours competing for five slots, so keeping a slot spare is no longer free. Nothing is hidden or locked: every colour has an exposed home from the first move, which is what makes the links the only thing to plan around. Orange is the spine - the owl beak and feet, the whole crown and the star core - so an orange container always has somewhere to go. The owl is the dig: its brown feathers cover the belly, the pupils and the eyes, so three colours wait behind one, and the snowflake is a single cyan board, a clean place to spend a container when a rope is not ready. The careless bot sits near 20% here whatever the picture set: swapping the snowflake for a three-colour candle was tried and moved it 23% to 20%, so the cost is the nine colours, not the boards.
